sources.label: MagicBrief FAQ
sources.claim: MagicBrief announced its wind-down and closed on 31 July 2026; Insights can export as CSV until shutdown, while Inspire collections have no bulk export.

sources.label: MagicBrief's Canva acquisition post
sources.claim: MagicBrief was acquired by Canva; the successor product is Canva Grow, sold inside Canva Business.
